steps.en: Copy a site's DESIGN.md into the project root
steps.zh: 把某站点的 DESIGN.md 拷到项目根目录

steps.en: Ships YAML tokens plus prose rules as a visual contract
steps.zh: 给出 YAML token 加散文规则当视觉契约

steps.en: Tell the agent to follow that file — harnesses do not auto-load it
steps.zh: 告诉 agent 按这份文件做，它不会自动加载

value.en: The agent generates UI in that brand language without you writing a design system
value.zh: 不用自写设计系统，agent 就按该品牌语言出 UI
